title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Amount Refunded for a Fee on a Certificate Funding Transfer
content:
Where a Savings & Money Market Accounts product bore an excess withdrawal fee on the internal transfer that funded a certificate of deposit, the sum handed back is fixed as follows.

## Rule

**Which fee.** The fee handed back is the excess withdrawal fee attached to that funding transfer, meaning the excess withdrawal fee whose source item is the funding transfer itself.

**How much.** Exactly what that fee took from the account when it posted, rounded half-up to the cent. Nothing is added and nothing is held back.

**When the sum is nil.** If no excess withdrawal fee is attached to the funding transfer, or if the account's tier counts internal transfers toward its allowance, the sum is nil and no refund is made under this policy.

## Worked examples (hypothetical)

| Fee attached to the funding transfer | Tier counts internal transfers | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| 13.25 | no | 13.25 |
| 9.50 | no | 9.50 |
| none | no | nothing |
| 9.50 | yes | nothing |

## Points of judgement

**Could the refund be a round goodwill figure, such as 20.00, instead of the fee?** No. It mirrors the posted fee to the cent.
